statement: Fear is the subject of 1 of 5 books (Brave Bora): it is named on page 2, called okay by a parent, rehearsed on a toy, and peaks at intensity 4 just before the solution.

scope.population: contemporary open-licence picture books (Book Dash, South Africa, 2021-2024)

magicpaper.current: fear, panic, grief, despair (intensity 3) never permitted at age 5-6
magicpaper.suggested: Open question, not a recommendation: whether named fear followed by adult support could be allowed mid-story. One book cannot answer it.
